lines.bus_stop_narration_01: Cold equatorial morning air settles over the empty avenue.{w=0.35} Only the distant hum of a late bus breaks the silence.
lines.bus_stop_narration_02: Press H or right-click at any time to hide the dialogue box and view the CG, or press Esc to pause and switch languages.
lines.bus_stop_chloe_01: ...Battery at eighty-four percent.{w=0.35} Still feels too early to pretend to be awake.
lines.bus_stop_chloe_02: Wait—if I miss the next bus, I'll walk into compilers class late again.{p} Keep it together, Chloe.
lines.bus_stop_chloe_03: Deep breath.{w=0.25} Even if I don't technically need oxygen, it helps blend in.
lines.unua_desk_narration_01: Light snow drifts past the apartment window while papers pile around the green desk lamp.
lines.unua_desk_unua_01: You're back late, Chloe.{w=0.35} Did you make it through the whole day without rattling a single cable loose?
lines.unua_desk_chloe_01: Ah—Professor Unua!{w=0.25} You're still revising the blueprints?
lines.unua_desk_chloe_02: Everything went fine, mostly...{p} Nobody noticed anything strange.
lines.unua_desk_unua_02: Good.{w=0.3} Sit down for a diagnostics sweep before your joints freeze up.
lines.unua_desk_chloe_03: Okay.{w=0.25} It's nice to be somewhere warm again.
lines.assistant_intro_01: Professor! The diagnostics terminal inside the study room is blinking again.
lines.unua_intro_02: ...Great.{w=0.45} I'll go through the study door...{p} and check the logs myself.
lines.assistant_repeat_01: The study door is just around the interior partition wall on the right.
lines.assistant_after_terminal_01: You pulled the diagnostics logs already? Everything looks green!
lines.unua_after_terminal_02: Clean memory disposal, zero leaks. Try saving from the Pause menu (Esc).
lines.terminal_check_01: Diagnostics terminal: Scene transition disposal and IndexedDB storage nominal.
lines.terminal_check_02: Flag [checked_terminal] set to true. Let's report back to the assistant.
lines.hallway_not_ready_01: Better check the diagnostics terminal in the study room before heading out.
lines.hallway_ready_01: All systems verified! Ready for the full 6-room Paper expressions prologue.
